title: Make trust-store persistence durable, private, and concurrency-safe
description: SECURITY/ROBUSTNESS: TrustStorePersistence.save writes a predictable shared .tmp without locking or O_EXCL, does not set the directory/file to 0700/0600, and renames without fsyncing the directory. Concurrent writers can interleave/replace each other's temporary file or lose updates, process umask may expose peer metadata, and a reported successful save can disappear after crash. Use a locked single-writer or generation/CAS protocol, unique same-directory temp with restrictive mode at creation, fsync file and directory, and tests for concurrent saves, symlink/temp collisions, permissions, and crash recovery.
